tagline: Two layers of foam for your dog, in a brown velvet you won't want to hide.
lead: Your dog gets memory foam that contours to them, egg-crate foam beneath for support, and a pillow edge for their chin.
value: Beds that look good in a room are often thin inside. This one pairs velvet you'd choose for a sitting room with two layers of foam.
intro: Walnut is a memory foam dog bed with a warm brown velvet sleeping surface, memory foam over an egg-crate foam base, a pillow bolster along one edge and a non-slip bottom. One size.
points: Memory foam on top to contour to them, with egg-crate foam beneath for support.
A bolster runs along one edge, and the other sides stay open.
A warm brown velvet sleeping surface that looks at home in a sitting room.
A non-slip bottom helps it hold its place on wooden floors and tiles.
best_for: Dogs who like to rest their chin on an edge, in homes where the dog bed lives in the sitting room.
fit_note: Walnut comes in one size. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm, then ask us for the exact measurements and whether it fits.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Let it air-dry fully before refitting, and never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Velvet Memory Foam Dog Bed with Pillow Edge | Snoozly
seo_description: A velvet memory foam dog bed with two foam layers and a pillow edge to rest their chin on. Warm brown velvet surface, non-slip bottom, one size.
